title: Oracle Evening Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin closed the US session at sixty-four thousand three hundred eighty-four dollars, up zero point four percent, holding firm in fear territory. The forty-six fear and greed reading shows sentiment remains cautious yet price refuses to break lower. Hashrate stays elevated at nine hundred forty-one exahashes, underscoring network strength.
